description: The phone app's one window (SPEC §4.15). It opens links in the person's browser, like the desktop list window, and calls only the app's own commands a text-only phone uses: the sign-ins, the gateway connections (gateway_retry tries one again at once when the app comes back to the screen), the start-up check (graphics_started, which does nothing off Linux), and its sounds (src/phone_sound.rs): the phone's ringer, which chimes follow, a chime played as a notification sound (sound_play, the desktop's call, limited the same way), and the buzz in place of one on vibrate; and the phone's Font size (src/phone_text.rs), which the page sizes its text and rows by. No notifications, no voice, no updates, no other windows: lib.rs's phone_app registers nothing else, and src/acl.rs checks the two agree. The desktop files say "platforms" so none of them applies here.
